{{Quote|With Mount Tantiss and the Emperor's collection of Spaarti cloning cylinders, the initiative is once again ours. Very soon, we'll begin taking planets back from the Rebellion... For that, we will need a well-trained army|Grand Admiral Thrawn, to Captain Gilad Pellaeon|<ref name="DFR" />}}
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], an '''army''' under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] was used in the [[Thrawn campaign|war effort]] to reclaim [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] from the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. In order to revive the former [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], Thrawn used [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|cloning cylinders]] located from [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] to [[Mount Tantiss project|resupply]] his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] forces. Thrawn also recruited senior [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]]&mdash;such as [[General/Legends|General]] [[Freja Covell]], General [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]], and [[High Colonel/Legends|High Colonel]] [[Zel Johans]]&mdash;to command his new ground forces.

The army worked in conjunction with the [[Thrawn's fleet (Galactic Empire)|fleet]], and often ground forces would be [[Ground warfare/Legends|deployed]] the take the planet. Typical symbols used by the army were Imperial [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and stormtroopers. However, after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Thrawn [[Battle of Bilbringi (9 ABY)|at]] [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilibringi]], the army slowly dissolved, remaining as holdouts, or joining Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]].
